about: National Aluminium Company Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of alumina and aluminum products in India and internationally. The company operates through Chemical and Aluminum segments. It offers aluminum metal products, such as ingots, alloy ingots, T-ingots, sows, billets, and wire rods; alumina and hydrate products, including calcined alumina and alumina hydrate; zeolite-A products; specialty alumina and hydrate products; and aluminum rolled and chequered sheets products.
